description: Fetch and validate a website's llms.txt file (the Markdown file that tells AI engines what the site is about and which pages matter). Returns its title, summary, sections, links, and any structural issues. Use when asked whether a site has llms.txt or how to improve it.

url.description: Website URL, e.g. https://example.com (llms.txt is derived from it)

name: inspect_llms_txt
